summary: Iteration 14 (Forgot/Reset Password admin-assisted) full-stack testing completed. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed — anti-enumeration generic response for registered/unregistered emails, dedupe of pending requests per user, admin/owner role excluded from creating records (but still returns generic 200), authz on /api/admin/password-resets (401 no token, 403 candidate, 200 admin), complete flow with password<6 → 400 and valid → 200 (old password 401, new password 200, old token 401 via iat check), reject flow (pending → rejected → re-complete 404), auth regression (login/me/register/logout), meta+jobs regression. Frontend: verified via Playwright — /login shows forgot-password-link, /forgot-password form submits and shows success state with back-to-login-btn, admin sidebar 'Reset Password' menu, /admin/password-resets page with 4 tabs, pending row list, reset-modal opens, reset-new-password-input+reset-submit-btn works, budi successfully logged in with new password set via UI, notifications (password_reset for admin, password_reset_done for user) confirmed via /api/notifications, mobile 390px overflow=0 on both pages. Cleanup executed: budi@example.com password restored to 'password123' (login verified 200) and all leftover pending requests rejected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now >4000 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, jobs, etc.). Already flagged in prior iterations but worth revisiting.
AdminPasswordResets uses window.confirm() for reject — okay for MVP but a shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent with rest of admin UI.

forgot_password endpoint response message is identical whether user exists or role is admin/owner — good for anti-enumeration. Timing side-channel is theoretically possible (extra DB writes when candidate/company) but negligible for this use case.
Notifications table 'password_reset_done' link=/login — user reading it is already logged in; consider deep-linking to profile settings instead. Minor UX.
